# Verify final state: fetch phone friends and venmo friends, then compare.
phone_friends = []
page = 0
while True:
    resp = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_login['access_token'], relationship='friend', page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    contacts = resp.get('contacts', [])
    phone_friends.extend(contacts)
    if len(contacts) < 20:
        break
    page += 1

venmo_friends = []
page = 0
while True:
    resp = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=venmo_login['access_token'], page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    friends = resp.get('friends', [])
    venmo_friends.extend(friends)
    if len(friends) < 20:
        break
    page += 1

phone_emails = {c['email'] for c in phone_friends if c.get('email')}
venmo_emails = {f['email'] for f in venmo_friends if f.get('email')}

print("Phone friend emails:", sorted(phone_emails))
